description: Smoke fixture for the bundled generate_image package: the recipe answers with the fixed line the chat turn gives the model. In a chat turn the hub answers the call itself and starts the picture job (backend/src/lib/pictures/tool.ts); that path is covered by backend/tests/pictureTool.test.ts, not this emulator.

inputs.prompt: a red fox in the snow

reply.text: A picture is being made from this description: a red fox in the snow. It appears below your reply when it is ready. You have not seen it: do not describe how it looks. Tell the person in one short sentence that it is on its way.
